posts.title: Case-sensitive multiselect in VS Code
posts.description: When I use multiselect (aka multiple cursor selection) in VS Code via Cmd+D (which is constantly), I usually prefer case-sensitive behavior when refactoring and finding things I can edit in-place at once. When I search via Cmd+F, I often prefer case-insensitive behavior as I’m looking for logic related to a word (could be a foo_bar or FooBar and I want Cmd+F, foo to find both).
